name: replynodes-web-search
title: Web Search API
description: x402 pay-per-call access to a read-only public web-search fetcher provider for AI agents, OpenSERP-backed across DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google, Yandex, Baidu, and Ecosia with zero credentials required and normalized v1 JSON responses. Public reads only: no login, no credentials, no proxies, no wallet signing, no agent identity required.

distribution.note: Registry status is verified independently after publication.

capabilities.summary: Public web search across DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google, Yandex, Baidu, Ecosia; x402 pay-per-call at $0.005 per request.

unsupported_capabilities.name: image_search
unsupported_capabilities.notes: Per-engine image search endpoint; out of V1 scope (issue #30 capability matrix).

unsupported_capabilities.name: url_extract
unsupported_capabilities.notes: Target-page fetching expands the egress surface; deferred beyond V1.

unsupported_capabilities.name: batch_extract
unsupported_capabilities.notes: Batch target-page fetching expands the egress surface; deferred beyond V1.

unsupported_capabilities.name: parse_html
unsupported_capabilities.notes: Raw HTML ingestion is unnecessary behind the bridge process boundary.

unsupported_capabilities.name: *write_or_authenticated
unsupported_capabilities.notes: No login, OAuth, cookie, session, wallet signing, transaction submission, or proxy-credential capability exists on this boundary, now or later (AGENTS.md rule 4).

unsupported_capabilities.name: *credential_access
unsupported_capabilities.notes: No login/session/cookie/OAuth material ever; the boundary is public-read and credential-free by construction (AGENTS.md rule 4).
